blocks.text: Fire Rated Doors in the UAE

Firestone Fire and Security Systems supplies and installs fire rated doors across the UAE, engineered to contain fire and smoke for a specified period and give building occupants time to evacuate safely. Every fire door we supply carries fire rating certification and is installed to meet civil defence and building code requirements across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and Al Ain.
What Is a Fire Rated Door

A fire rated door is a door assembly — including the frame, hinges, seals, and hardware — tested and certified to resist fire for a specific duration, commonly 30, 60, 90, or 120 minutes. Unlike a standard door, a fire rated door is built with fire-resistant cores, intumescent seals that expand under heat to block smoke, and self-closing mechanisms, so it only performs correctly when the full assembly is installed as certified rather than as individual components.

Our range includes steel fire rated doors for industrial and back-of-house areas, timber fire rated doors for commercial and residential interiors, and fire rated doors with vision panels where sightlines are required, such as corridors and stairwells. We also supply fire exit doors fitted with panic hardware for designated escape routes, in line with civil defence egress requirements.

Firestone supplies fire rated doors direct from our warehouse and manages full installation, including frame fitting, hardware, seals, and self-closing devices, so the finished assembly performs as certified. Our technicians install fire doors for new-build projects, fit-outs, and buildings upgrading existing doors to meet current fire safety requirements.

Fire rated doors need periodic inspection to confirm seals, hinges, and self-closing mechanisms remain in working condition, since damage or incorrect hardware can compromise the fire rating. We inspect and maintain installed fire doors, and replace doors that are damaged, non-compliant, or no longer meet the required fire rating for their location.

Firestone Fire and Security Systems has supplied and installed fire safety systems across the UAE since 2007, stocking fire rated doors and components at our dedicated warehouse to support fast turnaround on supply and installation. Our team handles fire door selection, supply, installation, and ongoing maintenance as a single service, so building owners and contractors don't need to coordinate multiple suppliers.
